name: playonline-fullstack

scripts.build: rm -rf .wrangler && mkdir -p frontend && cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd dist && echo 'export default { async fetch(request) { return fetch(request); } }' > _worker.js && cd ../.. && rm -rf frontend/node_modules
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy

description: PlayOnline - Full stack application with React frontend and Node.js backend
